sourceRules.firstOccurrenceScope: Only slowdown is asserted a whole-queue first, after scanning all 100 records. GN/TR/projectiles, busters, moving dots, EX, HY and classes4/5 already occur earlier.

slowdown.property: Raw bit0x20 becomes runtime look bit0x80. Dot-property mask miss clears it. Raw0x80 moving-program flag is separate and survives the miss.
slowdown.arrival: DOGrabbed human branch first selects occupied art198+colorOffset for a slowdown dot, then always calls WASetSlowdown(destination look&0x80). Nonhuman branch skips this. Ordinary human grab clears slowdown by passing0; it is not a toggle or occupancy refcount.
slowdown.departure: DOReleased human branch restores idle art189+colorOffset but does not call WASetSlowdown. Bounce, failed grab and mere visual contact do not change global state. Teleport destination is not recursively grabbed, so do not recompute slowdown there without the source hook.
slowdown.state: WASetSlowdown changes only current divisor+0x0c in classes1..5 to their stored normal+0x14 or slow+0x18 values. Class0 untouched. Counts, deltas, remainders and multiplier remain unchanged. Repeated identical state is a no-op; sound24 entering,25 leaving.
slowdown.latch: Current class delta was already latched; divisor writes do not recalculate it. Future WALatchTimer carries old remainder into the new divisor and consumes it normally. Returning to a smaller divisor may produce a catch-up increment; never zero/rephase the clocks.
slowdown.consumers: Every consumer of classes1..5 is affected, including moving dots/class1 and thrown buster clones using inherited class. Class0 hero and gun-bullet clock remain unchanged. Separate SP/ring/misc clocks must not be globally scaled. Consumer consequences are source composition, not newly observed native behavior.
slowdown.reset: WAStart forces normal at new level. WAReset reinitializes actors then calls DOInitialGrabbed for human slots in order, reapplying the final arrival state without rebuilding shared clocks. Both serialized human starts are non-slowdown in this batch. Checkpoint respawn and explicit restart must keep their established saved-spec/initial-grab ordering.
slowdown.art: Group300 and shadow4100 idle189..197 and occupied198..206, selected by source color offset. No new native anchor/visual qualification here.
slowdown.combined: Blowout89 has one moving slowdown dot, so global change affects that dot own subsequent class1 movement. Passage86 retains six moving programs while their slowdown properties are mask-disabled.
